NanoLabs Control Center / NanoMonitor - Third Party Notices

NanoThermal uses LibreHardwareMonitorLib 0.9.6.
Project: https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor
Package: https://www.nuget.org/packages/LibreHardwareMonitorLib/0.9.6
License: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (MPL-2.0)
License text: https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/blob/master/Licenses/LICENSE

Low-level hardware sensor access may use the official PawnIO driver.
Project: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO
Official binary releases: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Setup/releases
Bundled setup version: 2.2.0
NanoMonitor redistributes the official installer unchanged and verifies its SHA-256 at release build time.
NanoMonitor does not remove PawnIO automatically on uninstall because it is a shared system provider that may be used by other software.

These components are third-party software and are not authored by NanoLabs.
